summary: WHISPERS: Realm of the Nine is a multiplayer fantasy MMO spanning the Lantern March, race homelands, battlegrounds and themed dungeon/raid instances. MMORPG Tools owns character, realm and UI lifecycle; ordered player behaviors and shared data drive combat, quests, trade, guilds, flight and progression across streamed scenes.
places: places/main/config.yaml and places/main/cells/ - Lantern March continent; streamed cells hold Lantern's Reach, race towns, quest regions, encounters, gates and landmarks.
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - Lantern's Reach and Hall of Banners; Registrar Ambrose Quill (guild-registrar) connects nearby interaction to guild UI; guild-flagpole anchors local player banners.
places/main/cells/x-2z-9.scene, x-3z4.scene, x-6z1.scene, x0z-1.scene, x2z11.scene and x7z-1.scene - six race-start towns with matching Discipline Trainers and banners.
places/main/cells/x-10z7.scene and board scenes - Sorrowfen hub and race-town Party Finder boards; scripts/party-finder.js registers dungeon, raid and battleground queues.
places/main/cells/x-1z-5.scene, x-6z1.scene, x-7z0.scene and x0z-4.scene - Starfall giant quest site, Rootwake Glade bounty/raider camp and blood shrine.
places/main/cells/x2z11.scene and x-2z2.scene - Hask's Saltmere shop and Mott Farwander's traveling caravan on the Reedhaven road; storm parking switches Mott to a hot-tea inventory.
places/banner-vale/ - 5v5 capture-the-banner battleground; terrain/config, scenes and referee sim manage teams, flags, score and match return.
places/{hollowcrypt,drowned-bell,root-archive,pale-choir,emberheart,ninth-assembly}/ - dungeon/raid instances linked to the main world by paired gates.
roots: world.config.yaml - defaults to main-menu-land; binds player/camera templates, MMORPG UI, arrival redirect, routing and realm pulse.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/mod.json - registers MMORPG lifecycle, cameras, character/interaction behaviors and UI actions.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/version.js - GAME_VERSION 0.47.9 Alpha is displayed on main menu, settings and pause.
templates/player.js#player - ordered locomotion, movement, class, quest, vendor, guild, guild-flag, trades, flight, vitality, cursor-free and region-music behaviors.
templates/camera.js#camera - gameplay camera; MMORPG owns separate menu and character-creation camera paths.
places/main/config.yaml and places/main/sim.js - March terrain/atmosphere plus room weather and Party Finder matching.
places/banner-vale/config.yaml and places/banner-vale/sim.js - battleground terrain and referee simulation; assigns teams, manages flags/scores and returns players.
places/{hollowcrypt,drowned-bell,root-archive,pale-choir,emberheart,ninth-assembly}/config.yaml - instance terrain, gravity and spawn environment.
shared: mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/ - RPG registries, persistence, currency, shop data and UI modules reused by MMORPG behaviors and gameplay scripts.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/realm-save.js - character persistence, roster population and realm list/detail shared by menu and player lifecycle.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/player-panel-input.js - in-world panel action handlers; loaded only after a hero stands in-world and imports shop-data.js/profession-data.js for its handlers.
scripts/lib/places.js - PLAY/isPlay and SAFE_HOME registry used by quests, class actions, vitality, flight and regional music.
scripts/gen/instance.js - shared geometry/layout generator for dungeon and raid scenes; placements select layout and kind.
scripts/lib/data/quests.yml + MMORPG lib/quest-data.js - quest mechanics/database shared by quest-core, quest-giver and tracker; quest-text.js supplies prose.
scripts/lib/data/bosses.yml + scripts/boss.js - encounter definitions and common behavior for instance/open-world bosses; IDs also key gear and voice data.
scripts/lib/lazy.js and scripts/lib/resident-animation.js - lazy behavior forwarding for class, flight, vendor and vitality wrappers; resident idle/bow/pitch handling shared by Elric and townsfolk.
notableExports: scripts/lib/places.js - PLAY, isPlay, SAFE_HOME; scripts/gen/instance.js - LAYOUTS, roomsOf, geometry.
scripts/lib/kit.js - power, gearPower, classOf, canAct, forward, alive, aimPoint, softTargets, launch, materialOf, meleeFoley, applyHit.
scripts/lib/lazy.js - lazyBehavior; scripts/lib/resident-animation.js - residentIdle, greetResident, residentPitch.

scripts/{vanguard,arcanist,pathfinder,shade}-core.js - class action exports; wrappers expose handlers and defer to matching core modules; scripts/flight-core.js exports updateSchedule, onInput, update.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/player-panel-input.js - FALL, panelInput; MMORPG player.js imports it lazily after the character enters the world.
scripts/vendor-core.js and scripts/vendor.js - core exports ears, coins_ear, onInput, update; wrapper exposes ears, onInput, update and lazy-loads the core.
scripts/vitality-core.js and scripts/vitality.js - core exports bloodEnds, onInput, updateSchedule, update; wrapper forwards these via lazy load.
scripts/gen/homeland.js - geometry, collider; params.kind selects hollow, vault, reedcage or bloom geometry.
ownership: scripts/player.js - room-local movement intent and velocity/footstep state; place config owns gravity.
MMORPG player.js and lib/realm-save.js - active character, roster snapshots and persisted character records, including professions, inventory, equipment, quest state and trained rank.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/player-panel-input.js - in-world door/shop/profession and related panel input state transitions; player.js owns its lazy import and supplies host helpers.
scripts/{vanguard,arcanist,pathfinder,shade}-core.js - class action/cooldown state and combat effects; wrapper scripts load and forward to the matching core.
scripts/flight-core.js - player roost discovery, flight map, flying mount/route state and fare interaction; saved roosts live on character state.

scripts/quest-core.js - quest interactions, progression, dialogue, inventory/cache/mark state, owedItems delivery and _questSave; quest-player.js owns kill tally/XP, lockouts, loot and equipment-derived maxHealth.

scripts/vendor-core.js - vendor/bank state and shop transactions; copper purse changes use scripts/lib/economy.js, inventory and bank belong to the character save. scripts/vitality-core.js owns health, food, death/rising, PvP-zone and Blood Moon state.
scripts/boss.js - placed boss hp/mode/cast/enrage/target fields; encounter clocks, damage attribution and target scratch live in boss ctx.session.
flows: world.config.yaml defaultPlace main-menu-land → main-menu-mgr/main-menu UI → realm roster or character selection → creation/enter-world → gameplay lifecycle.

Arrival outside main-menu-land without fresh _worldEnterAt or creation-place _creationEnterAt → scripts/arrival.js redirects to menu; menu and crypt/instance gates stamp allowed transitions; routing validates requested room, then saved route.

main-menu-mgr loads current-room SQL roster; api.enterPlace routes selected character to saved place/position. scripts/lib/data/realms.yml → routing.js and crons/realm-pulse.js; cron writes room player count to realm_pulse, realm-save reads roster/detail data.
Character creation race/class → lib/races.js start and character state → MMORPG player.js/realm-save upsert to characters keyed by user, realm and slot.

templates/player.js order → locomotion → movement → class handlers → quest-player → vendor → guild → guild-flag → trades → flight → vitality → cursor-free → region-music; movement/camera intents are consumed by player.js/wow-move.js.

MMORPG player.js warms and dynamically imports lib/player-panel-input.js after a created hero stands outside a meta place; panel module imports shop-data.js and profession-data.js and receives input/state/host helpers from player.js.

MMORPG ui.js starts warming its HUD modules on first paint after the menu stands; chat, tip reminders and buff icons now join the deferred HUD imports and render through lazy wrappers, alongside HUD/quest/vendor/trades and other panels.

On main, scripts/vendor.js warms/forwards input and update to vendor-core.js for created non-creating characters; vendor interactions and vendor/bank UI actions write character state, and coin rewards enter through the coins ear/economy ledger.

In a PLAY place, scripts/vitality.js warms/forwards to vitality-core.js; enemies write state.health, vitality reads it and handles food, death/rise, healing and PvP rules. A change to the template's vitality wrapper reaches this behavior.

In PLAY, eligible class wrapper input/update → lazy import matching *-core.js; flight wrapper similarly loads flight-core.js. First eligible quest-player input/update → quest-core; quest-core seeds quest-data from quests.yml, quest-text supplies prose.
Main-place entrance gate config → instance-gate checks player/level and active quest, stamps _worldEnterAt and crosses to paired +place#gate; inside twin returns through its link.

Party Finder board scripts/party-finder.js queues a hero in world.state.lfg; places/main/sim.js prunes absent players and matches from finder.yml, stamps _worldEnterAt, updates eligible quest tallies and crosses to dungeon/battleground. places/main/sim.js weather state storm.on freezes/resumes caravan-route and switches Mott's shop to mott-storm.
behaviorFamilies: scripts/gen/instance.js - reused across instance places, varied by layout (room dimensions, corridor length, materials/colors) and kind; scene placements share layout coordinates.
scripts/boss.js + scripts/lib/data/bosses.yml - one AI across dungeon/raid and open-world placements, varied by boss definition: hp, arena, abilities/telegraphs, phases, enrage and rewards.
scripts/gen/homeland.js - landmarks/foliage reused at homeland encounter sites, varied by kind (hollow, vault, reedcage, bloom), scale and seed; scenes bind static colliders.

scripts/gen/ashen.js, scripts/gen/ashen-village.js and scripts/gen/grave-ground.js - Ashen Close graveyard, cathedral yard, gothic village pieces and graveyard cover; helper, kind, seed, LOD and dimensions vary pieces.
scripts/gen/fen.js - procedural marsh props recur in Sorrowfen, Reedhaven Refuge and Starfall Eyrie quest sites, varied by kind/seed/LOD; boardwalk geometry and collider share dimensions.
scripts/gen/tide.js - Tideglass structures and props share shape helpers; kind/LOD/length/width vary each piece.
scripts/gen/hamlet.js, scripts/gen/roothome.js and scripts/gen/stilt.js - reused in race hamlets and March settlements, varied by kind, seed, dimensions and stilt/deck height.
scripts/{vanguard,arcanist,pathfinder,shade}.js + matching *-core.js - same lazy-load/forward pattern for four player class kits; class identity selects warmup and each core owns that kit's actions.
probableOrphans: scripts/gen/grave-weeds.js - no scene or other package reference; graveyard cover is currently placed through grave-ground.js instead.
migrationNotes: Adding a playable place requires a row in scripts/lib/places.js PLAY; dying heroes rise at SAFE_HOME for listed dungeons/raids. Quest and class logic uses isPlay rather than hard-coded place names.

Instance room walls/corridors and scene furnishing placement share layout coordinates: entry is z=0, chambers chain toward -Z, floor y=0; keep scripts/gen/instance.js roomsOf arithmetic consistent with scenes.
Gate links are explicit +place#object links on paired gates; instance-gate checks minLevel and active enterQuest, stamps _worldEnterAt for arrival.js, and only then counts enterTally.

Boss combat shares hp/lastHitBy/lastHitAt; boss.js emits kills to hero behavior machines so quest-player owns tally/XP and gear rolls. Keep scene boss IDs aligned with bosses.yml and associated gear/voice data.

Cache keys use state.cache or object id; explicit copper overrides legacy gold × 100, and st.caches belongs to the character save (new character initializes it empty). Guild vault moves use SQL version-conditional updates.

MMORPG player.js must keep player-panel-input off the menu boot path; that in-world module now statically imports shop-data.js and profession-data.js once loaded. ui.js defers chat, tip reminder and buff-icon modules with the HUD imports after first paint.
